title: Pokemon TCG Seel Base Set 41/102 Regular Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: A vintage 1999 Pokémon TCG card from the Base Set featuring the Water-type Pokémon Seel. This Standard-sized, English-language card is an Unlimited edition, with a Regular finish and Uncommon rarity. Manufactured by Wizards of the Coast, it is made of durable card stock material. The card depicts Seel at the Basic stage of evolution, with the card number 41/102. A collectible item suitable for ages 6 and up.
